crossRefs.note: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years: until all…
Moreover Yahweh’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.
because all those men who have seen my glory, and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have…
Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them…
don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
